pr_title: fix(docs-infra): prevent search-bar from overlapping nav-items
pr_body:
As part of angular.io's responsive layout, the menu shown in the top-bar is collapsed into the sidenav on narrow screens at the point where the search-bar (on the right side of the top-bar) would overlap with the menu's nav-items.

Previously, the value used as break-point would work on marketing pages, where the hamburger button is not shown on wide screens. However, on docs pages (where the hamburger button is always shown, pushing the menu further to the right), the search-bar would still overlap the menu nav-items on some resolutions.

This commit fixes it by raising the screen width threshold at a value that ensures there is no overlap even on pages where the hamburger button is visible alongside the top-bar menu.

Fixes #37667.

##
This PR also includes some refactorings in preparation of the fix. See individual commits for details.
